title: ShoppingQuote
description: Sourcing decision for one part to buy. Selection and budget enforcement are deterministic (A5): the chosen candidate is the one selection_rule picks from the candidates, and total never exceeds budget.cap. AI may only discover candidates and extract datasheet fields; ai_assist records where it was used.

cap.description: Hard cap for this part including shipping estimate.

price_source.description: reference_bom prices are treated as current.

spec_match.description: exact_mpn: same part. equivalent: same spec within tolerance. substitute: researched, needs the quick check.

protective_part_check.description: A substitute for a protective part must be passed or it is ineligible (S2).

eligible.description: Passed every deterministic filter (spec_match, protective check, in budget).

found_by.description: How the candidate entered the list. AI may add candidates; it cannot pick one.

chosen_index.description: Index into candidates, or null when nothing is eligible within budget.

selection_rule.description: Name of the deterministic rule applied, e.g. 'eligible, then exact_mpn before equivalent before substitute, then lowest total within cap, then shortest lead'. Versioned in code.

total.description: unit_price * qty + shipping for the chosen candidate. Must be <= budget.cap.

made_alternative.description: Print-it option from the reference model, when one exists.

file.description: STEP or STL path for the part, or a pilot export.

est_cost_source.description: pilot_estimate = a rough print estimate (PLA grams, minutes, material $; not sliced) for simple printed parts; otherwise unknown ('no price').

printer_available.description: True when the user has a 3D printer.
